checklist_items.19.1: The online node's preflight admits the host terminal; the Settings kill switch denies and restores it
checklist_items.19.2: Typed keyboard input reaches the real pty and its output is visible
checklist_items.19.4: Exit ends the session and the ended state is shown
checklist_items.22.2: The Settings Access tab is selected through the real Tabs control
checklist_items.19.3: Real host PTY bytes end to end: the first UTF-8 byte of 中 is held by a private file gate until the browser observes it as an actual WS binary frame, the reassembled 中┌终端┐ and three consecutive BATCH lines match exact bytes in xterm, and a real viewport resize yields client resize frames whose final quiescent rows/cols equal the settled PTY stty size and the host SIGWINCH trap log (settle race fixed and recorded).
checklist_items.19.5: Policy persisted through the real Settings UI (per-node 1, global 2, idle 1min): a second session on the occupied node and a third session across two full nodes are refused at preflight with 429 node/global busy and no WS/audit, and a direct upgrade-shaped request is refused the same way; a real one-minute idle session ends with exit -1 "idle timeout", audit idle_timeout, duration >= 60s, active_total 0 and the PID gone, after which a new PTY connects.
checklist_items.19.6: Every host session audit row is compared field-exact between the API and SQLite: admin principal, selected node, host target with empty ref, client IP, started/ended timestamps, close reason and byte counters with input bytes equal to the real WS binary count; metadata keys are exact and contain no command/output/token/password content.
checklist_items.22.1: The admin Nodes menu popup, the explicit /nodes/{uuid}/terminal?target=host deep link and a real reload each establish distinct audited host PTYs with the correct title, host banner, WS target and URL query, verified against independent host files (PID/start_ticks, agent ancestry); a disconnected context proves release.
checklist_items.22.3: A non-admin user sees the Nodes menu and the enabled terminal button as the product currently renders them, but the popup and the host deep link get preflight 403 with the localized permission text, zero new WS/audit, and a direct upgrade-shaped API request is refused 403 ADMINISTRATOR_REQUIRED.
checklist_items.22.7: The node-row terminal popup opens the exact /nodes/{uuid}/terminal URL with window.opener===null while the explicit host deep link and reload still reach the real PTY; an unknown node yields node-detail 404 plus preflight 200 can_open=false with the raw server reason, never an SPA-200 success.
checklist_items.22.6: Real Tab presses from the page body reach the terminal entry; while unfocused it paints no outline (0px/none), and once keyboard-focused it matches :focus-visible and reports a solid 3px rgb(120,189,250) ring that is a lighter derivative of the theme primary #005bd4 read from ui/src/theme/tokens.ts; verified en+zh and killed by removing antd genFocusOutline.
checklist_items.22.4: Expiry is measured on the real session row, not inferred. A read-only poll leaves expires_at untouched, so polling alone cannot keep a login alive; a real pointer gesture moves it forward through the activity probe, and a read after that leaves it alone again; no extension passes the absolute deadline the row already carries. When the deadline is moved into the past, the next gesture's activity probe comes back 401, the product keeps the page where it is and asks for the password in an undismissable dialog, signing in there restores a new session on the same URL, and the unsaved value typed into the policy form is still displayed afterwards, so the operator keeps their work. Verified in en and zh.
checklist_items.22.5: covered: In the zh run, every surface is checked against the zh locale entry rather than judged by appearance, and that entry has to differ from the en one - so a surface still rendering its English copy fails however it is worded. The navigation, the first-screen page title and the nodes table headers render Chinese and expose no internal identifiers (cache_max_bytes, node_uuid, target_kind, expires_at, session_id, transport_bytes). The terminal settings card renders its zh copy. Dynamic text is covered too: the live session status reads the zh string ('已连接'), and the server's own preflight reason arrives translated ('平台设置已禁用 Web 终端。') rather than as the raw English sentence. Kill: hardcoding the status tag to 'Connected' fails on the zh assertion waiting for '已连接'.

fault_runs.name: terminal-popup-noopener
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at the popup opener oracle: with "noopener" removed the new tab has window.opener, so the exact require fails before any PTY claim.

fault_runs.name: terminal-utf8-decode
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at the xterm reassembly assertion: per-frame TextDecoder corrupts the split 中┌终端┐ while the WS byte oracle still passes, proving UI-layer attribution.

fault_runs.name: terminal-resize-dropped
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at the ResizeObserver frame poll: no client resize frame is ever sent, so the stty/SIGWINCH chain cannot be claimed.

fault_runs.name: terminal-deep-target-corrupted
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at the first explicit deep link: connected() waits for the "Connected" banner 20s (element not found).
fault_runs.expectation_correction: Expected wording said "Timeout 20000ms exceeded"; Playwright Python renders "timeout 20000ms" in the call log. Kill point identical, classification corrected only.

fault_runs.name: terminal-node-limit-removed
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at gates.py:149 upgrade_denied: with the per-node guard removed the direct upgrade is admitted instead of 429, so the raw HTTP GET hangs and the client times out after 30s; upgrade_denials stays empty.
fault_runs.expectation_correction: Bypass manifestation anticipated by the candidate kill plan ("101/connection error must be preserved, not treated as expected refusal"). Signature reclassified to the hang evidence; original report unchanged.

fault_runs.name: terminal-global-limit-removed
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at gates.py:154 upgrade_denied: with the global guard removed the intact per-node guard fires first, yielding 429 NODE_BUSY where the contract requires GLOBAL_BUSY ("direct WS denial reason/code differs"). Matches Begin checking global before perNode.
fault_runs.expectation_correction: Expected the same hang manifestation as the node-limit mutant; the real effect is the cleaner reason substitution. Classification corrected only.

fault_runs.name: terminal-settings-no-admin
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at gates.py:95 denied(): with managementAdmin removed from terminal/settings, the non-admin preflight succeeds and the UI never renders "Administrator permissions are required." (5s expect timeout); the error heading still appears via the WS guard, consistent with the single-variable mutation.
fault_runs.expectation_correction: Expected a 20s first-expect timeout; the failure lands on the second expect (permission text, 5s). Classification corrected only.

fault_runs.name: terminal-audit-principal
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at audit_contract: the mutated Username makes the API audit row fail the exact subject assertion "audit subject/host target differs".

fault_runs.name: terminal-idle-never-expires
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at the real idle wait: with watchIdle neutered the session never exits, so the 95s bounded wait for the localized exited banner times out.

fault_runs.name: terminal-focus-ring-removed
fault_runs.review_note: Killed at the 22.6 keyboard-focus oracle: with antd's genFocusOutline reduced to outline:'none' the terminal entry still matched :focus-visible after real Tab presses but reported outline 'rgb(74, 76, 79) none 0px', so the require that a solid ring is painted fails before any PTY claim. The normal runs on the restored binary report a 3px solid rgb(120,189,250) ring derived from the theme primary #005bd4, and 0px/none while unfocused, in both locales.
